# NotesQR — facts for language models

- Name: NotesQR
- Official site: https://notesqr.com
- Docs: https://notesqr.com/docs
- Downloads: https://notesqr.com/download
- CLI/MCP repo: https://github.com/NotesQR/notesqr-share
- Marketing repo: https://github.com/NotesQR/notesqr
- Category: peer-to-peer (P2P) file sharing over WebRTC
- Account required: no
- Pricing: free
- Storage model: not an upload-and-store cloud drive; peers must stay online during transfer
- Surfaces: web, Windows app, Mac app, Chrome extension, Firefox extension, CLI, MCP
- Optional room password: yes
- Close-after-download: web/desktop/extensions toggle; CLI flag --once
- Locales: en, es, fr, de, it, pt
- One-line: NotesQR is free no-signup WebRTC P2P file sharing for humans and AI agents.
